caption: The drawing depicts the front elevation of a building rendered in black and white with fine dot and line work, possibly using ink or graphite. The building is rectangular with a gabled roof, and the roof is illustrated with a shingle or tile pattern. At the center of the facade, there is a prominent arched doorway flanked by two rectangular columns or pilasters that extend from the base to the entablature above the doorway. The entablature is indicated by horizontal lines and intervening shadow. Above the doorway, a small rectangular window is set into the gable, surrounded by a simple frame. There are visible cracks or lines on the building’s surface, adding texture. Below the illustration, two ribbon-shaped banners contain text: the upper left smaller banner reads “1791” and the larger central banner reads “mision de santa cruz.” A small handwritten signature, “sjones,” is located at the right end of the lower banner. The drawing is centered on an otherwise plain, light background without any additional objects or decorations.
title: Mision de Santa Cruz
